title: Kuro's winter venue
question: The outdoor pool closes after day three, before Kuro can reach the planned 14-point swimming meeting. Should her later meetings use the winter gym, or should swimming remain available all year?

options.label: Use the winter gym
options.note: Recommended: adapt the activity and booking dialogue to the existing winter gym. Keep the relationship choices, including her waiting for the player to invite her after a refusal.

options.label: Keep swimming year-round
options.note: Preserve swimming and establish a year-round venue and schedule. This requires additional setting and implementation work. After a refusal, the player still initiates the later invitation.

decision: Keep Kuro swimming. Jørgen rejects the seasonal premise: no winter, climate or calendar is being added. Do not move her meetings to a winter gym or create a year-round venue requirement. Preserve the approved refusal behavior. Plan and scope correction: #428. Existing seasonal runtime cleanup: #436.
